recipe.text: Distinct concept: a LEFT SIDEBAR main menu (vs prior centered menus) — 340px dark rail (18,20,26) anchored mid-left, UIListLayout stacked: kicker label, GothamBlack 42pt title IRONHOLLOW, amber pill divider, amber PLAY primary button, neutral SETTINGS button, footer. SETTINGS opens a side sub-panel with two text toggles. PLAY tween-slides the rail out and disables the gui. All styling UICorner+UIStroke, Gotham family fonts.
